title: Best Shopify Apps to Boost AOV (Average Order Value)
summary: Want a higher AOV without more traffic? These Shopify apps use personalization, upsells, and bundling to raise your average order.

Build reusable product bases, templates, and clipart libraries, or add personalization to products already published in your store, helping merchants expand their personalized catalog without starting from scratch.

Turn standard products into meaningful, one-of-a-kind purchases and offer richer customization options that can justify premium pricing, encourage upgrades, and increase the value of each order.

**Key Features:**

## **What to Consider When Choosing an AOV-Boosting App 💡**


Before committing to any Shopify app, think about the specific needs of your store. Some merchants only need basic upsells, while others want advanced personalization or post-purchase funnels.


Here are a few factors to weigh:


- **Product Type:** Personalized gifts, apparel, and home décor may benefit from visual upsells or customization.


- **Customer Journey:** Apps that enhance the checkout or thank-you page can capture extra revenue without disrupting the flow.


- **Automation:** Choose apps that integrate with your existing POD or fulfillment systems to save time and avoid manual work.


- **Ease of Setup:** Some upsell tools are plug-and-play, while personalization engines require more setup but yield higher ROI.


- **Scalability:** Look for apps that can grow with your business as you add new products or sales channels.


**Example scenarios:**


- If you sell custom jewelry, prioritize apps that combine personalization and bundling.


- If you sell home décor, focus on visual upsells or live previews to inspire add-on purchases.


- For digital or quick-turn products, consider post-purchase upsells that don’t slow checkout.


By matching your app choice to your business model, you’ll be better equipped to grow both your **AOV and customer satisfaction** .
